title: Trumpet at the Park
description: Kid-2 asks Grandma to take him to the park to practice his trumpet. She agrees enthusiastically, happy to move the music out of the house.
alt: In a cozy living room, kid-2 wears a navy hoodie and holds a brass trumpet. He asks, 'Grandma, can you take me to the park to practice my trumpet?' Grandma, wearing a cream sweater and holding her coat, smiles and replies, 'Absolutely.'
